description: Make a change to a design from this chat: pass its design id (d_...) and the change in plain words ("make the border gold", "change TROOP 42 to TROOP 24"). Use it for a change the user asks for later in the chat too, so the original artwork is kept. Returns a new design with its own id; the original stays. Counts as one design.

designId.description: The design id from the design_patch or edit_patch result for that design, e.g. d_1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b, not its D- number. It works in any later turn of the chat.

instruction.description: The change, in plain words. 2 to 800 characters.

name: edit_patch
title: Change a design
